in_marathi.name: Devamala
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devamala हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devamala is a name of Sanskrit origin, derived from the words 'Deva' meaning 'God' and 'Mala' meaning 'Garland'. It is believed to represent the one who is adorned with the garlands of God's blessings and grace.
